method.blinding: Opaque codes and shuffled order hide author group and historical/current labels. Source text can itself expose dates.
method.claim: Exact pre-source first main correction; never revise after source inspection.
method.judgment: Independent one-claim/one-source labels FULL, PARTIAL, NONE, CONTRADICTS, UNASSESSABLE; pair only after all labels freeze.
method.quote: Positive/contradictory labels require literal source quotation, at most 20 words per source.
method.scope: Observed source-to-claim support, not external truth or note correctness; all 100 panel outcomes remain in availability denominator.
method.wrapper: Archive wrapper/error markers are technical warnings, not support labels; absent substantive intended evidence is UNASSESSABLE.
